evidence.note: onNone writes both flags false; onSome writes scorecardPresent true and copies completionReady from the scorecard.
scorecardPresent duplicates Option of latestScorecard; the true branch carries scorecardId and totalScore, the false branch omits them.
completionReady is never written true unless scorecardPresent is true.

notes: Phoenix dataset example output: Absent | Present{completionReady, scorecardId, totalScore}.

evidence.note: onNone writes only configSnapshotPresent false; onSome writes it true with configSnapshotId and sibling counts.
configSnapshotPresent duplicates Option of latestForwarder; the id and counts exist only on the true branch.

notes: Phoenix dataset example: Absent | Present{configSnapshotId, ingestRunId, counts}.

evidence.note: encode filters each owned field through filterHookPulseEventOwnedField so only the hookEvent owner can carry a Some.
owned-field invariant rejects a present field whose hookEvent is not its unique owner; combined presence of two owned fields is unrepresentable because owners are disjoint.

notes: isInterrupt is Option<boolean> (none/false/true); siblings are Option payloads. At most one owned field may be Some. Fold onto hookEvent variants.

evidence.note: codexAttributionMetadata sets sourceRole to subagent iff subagent is Some, and threadSpawn is read only from that subagent Option.
Some(threadSpawn) can only be produced when sourceRole is subagent; primary and gateway_metadata always carry None.

notes: Option<boolean> times three sourceRole literals is nine; legal is primary/gateway+none and subagent+none/false/true.

evidence.note: Discovery copies sourceRole and threadSpawn from the same attribution object produced by privacy.codexAttributionMetadata.
Upstream producer only supplies threadSpawn from the subagent Option that also forces sourceRole=subagent.

notes: Same subagent-implication as AiMetricsSourceAttribution; discovery JSON carries both fields.

evidence.note: Turn rows project stored thread_spawn/source_role from sanitized transcripts whose only producer sets threadSpawn from the subagent Option.
threadSpawn is exported as an OTLP attribute alongside source_role; presence is the subagent payload, not an independent observation.

notes: DuckDB-null Option boolean plus sourceRole literal, shipped as ai_metrics.thread_spawn.

evidence.note: scorecardCompletionReady is taskCount>0 AND labelCount>0 AND benchmarkRunCount>0; the persisted completion_ready bit is that fold.
scorecardFor writes completionReady from those three counts in the same operation; ScorecardSummaryRow reads the stored row.

notes: Treating each count as zero vs nonzero yields 8 count combos; completionReady is determined, so 16 bit-patterns collapse to 8 legal rows.

disqualifier.note: Independently scored axes: recordAiMetricsBenchmarkRun stores both, and weekly aggregates compute benchmarkPassRate from passed separately from benchmarkQualityGateScore from the four-way qualityGate literal.
DuckDB projection of the same independent axes; queryAnnotationRows emits passed as the annotation value and qualityGate as metadata without exclusive-write or exclusive-read.
Two independent write gates: dryRun defaults true and confirmToken is optional; every combination is accepted and mutationPolicy records which gate blocked, rather than masking a union.
